steps.say: The small pencil beside the class name is how a class gets renamed. It sits at the top of the class page, next to the name itself.
Tapping it asks you for the new name and does nothing until you give it one. Closing the box leaves the class exactly as it was.
Only the name changes. The roster, the join link, the join code and the class's place on the course all carry on as they were.
steps.terminal: That's renaming a class — a new label on the same class. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
